sources.title: OLMo: Open Language Model - GitHub
sources.snippet: OLMo is a repository for training and using AI2's state-of-the-art open language models. It is designed by scientists, for scientists.

sources.title: allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-DPO · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OLMo 2 1B DPO April 2025 is post-trained variant of the allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-SFT model, which has undergone supervised finetuning on an OLMo-specific variant of the Tülu 3 dataset and further DPO training on this dataset.

sources.snippet: AMD-OLMo-1B-SFT is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find AMD-OLMo-1B-SFT on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of AMD-OLMo-1B-SFT install, users can directly use AMD-OLMo-1B-SFT installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial.
